acceptance: Workflow tests cover: tip with successful push run exits early; tip with failed push run exits early; tip with cancelled or missing push run runs the gates; lookup error runs the gates.
A simulated dropped-push case (no push run for the tip) still runs the full sweep gates.
After landing, 24 hours of scheduled runs show early exits on covered tips and the covering run ID in each step summary.
Post-landing note reports scheduled runner-minutes for the first 7 days against the ~5,000 per 25 days baseline.
context:
Landed in #2164 on 2026-09-17. Post-landing measurement, 2026-09-17 to 2026-09-24, from the Actions runs API.

Scheduled `develop-post-merge.yml` runs in the window: 44, all concluded `success`. 23 of 44 completed in under five minutes (early exit on a covered tip); 21 ran the gates. Worked example of an early exit: run 36017154257 on 2026-09-24, where `sweep-coverage` and `queue-certification` succeeded and `lint`, `fast-test`, `medium-test` and `explorer-tokens` were all skipped.

Early exits are about 52% of sweeps, not the ~100% the 204-of-204 baseline implied. Two causes, both intended: develop moves often enough that the tip is genuinely uncovered at sweep time, and guardrail 1 deliberately runs the gates when the covering push run is cancelled, missing or still running. The coverage rule was not loosened to raise the rate.

Cost comparison is approximate. Median run wall-clock in the window is 161s against 18-26 runner-minutes per pre-change sweep, but these are run wall-clock figures from the runs API rather than summed job time, so treat the comparison as order-of-magnitude rather than an exact runner-minute delta.

Implementation and tests: `scripts/sweep_coverage.py` with `tests/unit/workflows/test_sweep_coverage.py`. The push-drop gap detector was left unchanged, mutation jobs remain disabled on schedule, and the hourly cadence is unchanged.
description:
The `schedule` trigger in `develop-post-merge.yml` exists to cover dropped push events. It currently re-runs lint, fast-test, and explorer-tokens on the develop tip every hour, whether or not that tip was already tested.

Evidence (2026-08-23 to 2026-09-16): 204 of 204 scheduled runs were on a SHA that already had a push run. Sampled scheduled runs cost 18-26 runner-minutes each, roughly 5,000 runner-minutes over the window. Tip a4599a9 was swept three consecutive times unchanged.

Change: the sweep first checks whether the tip SHA is already covered. It exits with a step-summary note when covered, and runs the existing gates otherwise.
